title: Remove holiday
purpose: Remove a holiday from a business calendar, with a reason that is kept in the calendar's history.
summary: Remove a holiday from a calendar and say why. Clocks then run on that day again when due times are worked out afterwards. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Remove a holiday
steps: Check the holiday's name and date shown above the field.
Write the [[Reason for removal]] and select [[Remove holiday]].

tasks.title: Keep the holiday
steps: Select [[Cancel]] to return to the calendar without changes.

good_to_know: A reason is required. It is kept with the removal in the calendar's history.
Due times already worked out do not move.
The holiday itself is deleted and can be added again. Only the history of its removal stays.
If the holiday was already removed, the page cannot be opened and shows a not found message.

items.label: Holiday summary
items.description: The holiday's name and date, with a reminder that due times already worked out do not move.

items.label: Reason for removal
items.description: Required. Kept with the removal in the calendar's history.

items.label: Remove holiday
items.description: Deletes the holiday and records who removed it, when and why, with the holiday's date and name as they were. Returns to the calendar's page. This cannot be undone; add the holiday again if it was a mistake.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the calendar's page without removing anything.
